about_the_game:
At unknown coordinates in the depths of space, there exists an AI-controlled secret base where all information about human civilization is stored. Around this base lies an area known as the "Astral Battlefield", where wars against external threats have always taken place in an abstract form. On Earth, some humans are teleported here through "Starlight Projection" technology and form troops, while all external threats are projected as opposing forces. As a commander, your mission is to lead your troops to victory in turn-based battles on a "random" battlefield.

Game Features:
  • Battlefield: 8x4 grid size, where troops from both sides are randomly mixed on the grid tiles, all tiles are covered at the start;
  • Flip: each turn you can flip one tile, revealing an allied or enemy warrior and gaining 1 energy point;
  • Energy: warriors consume energy to use special abilities;
  • Troops: 16 warriors in total between both sides;
  • Warrior Types: there are 7 different types of warriors, each with unique abilities.
